usage: Continuity = elements keep identity across cuts; state survives time. These are checkable constraints the QA pass enforces.

rules.check: an element that persists across a transition must share one layer id + seeded color/geometry lineage
rules.why: viewer reads it as the same object

rules.check: cut on motion: outgoing velocity direction continues in incoming (angle delta <25°) unless the edit argues contrast
rules.tool: sample 2 frames either side of cut from contact sheet

rules.check: key light azimuth fixed per scene (record angle in style.json); shadows and gradients derive from it
rules.fail_action: rotate shadow vectors, do not just dim

rules.check: a chart's axis units persist through camera moves; type size step between hierarchy levels ≥1.5× and constant within a scene
each semantic claim binds to one accent; reappearances reuse exact hex from palette_set, no drift
clocks/timelines advance monotonically; loops are intentional and flagged in layer plan
a word never changes font/weight mid-shot without narrative reason; line order stays RTL-consistent after any bidi isolation
accent hits land within ±1 frame of the onset they claim; measured from onset file, not eyeballed
≥6 frames of stillness before a hard cut unless the cut-on-motion rule is used deliberately
seek(t) reproduces every element state; no accumulated jitter — compare digests tA,tB,tA

enforcement: quality skill runs these on the draft tier contact sheets + measured numbers; failures become journal issues with fixed-frame evidence.
